name: Six of Cups
meaning_for_today: Today may bring memories, reunions, nostalgia, or contact with people from the past. Warm emotions and sincere kindness will help restore harmony.
card_advice: Appreciate sincere emotions, childhood memories, and meaningful connections, but do not become trapped in the past. Use past experience wisely.

upright.short: Nostalgia, kindness, memories, reunion, emotional warmth.
upright.general: The Six of Cups symbolizes pleasant memories, nostalgia, emotional comfort, and sincere relationships. It often points to reunions, childhood memories, old friends, or acts of kindness and generosity. The card reflects innocence, trust, and emotional healing.
upright.in_love: Warm, sincere feelings, emotional tenderness, and romantic nostalgia. The card may indicate reconciliation, reunion with a former partner, or a relationship based on trust and emotional comfort.
upright.in_situation: The situation develops through kindness, support, and past experience. Help from familiar people or lessons from the past may play an important role.

reversed.short: Living in the past, emotional stagnation, unrealistic nostalgia.
reversed.general: Reversed, the Six of Cups may indicate difficulty letting go of the past, emotional immaturity, or unrealistic idealization of old memories. A person may avoid present responsibilities.
reversed.in_love: Attachment to past relationships, emotional immaturity, or inability to move forward emotionally. Old wounds may interfere with present happiness.
reversed.in_situation: The situation may involve emotional stagnation or excessive focus on the past. It is important to live in the present and adapt to change.

major.02: Using past experience and emotional intelligence.
major.03: Intuition connected to memories and emotions.
major.04: Warmth, care, family comfort, emotional support.
major.08: Moving forward while holding onto the past.
major.11: A fortunate reunion or emotional opportunity.
major.12: Fairness and honesty in emotional matters.
major.13: Letting go of the past and emotional transformation.
major.16: Painful memories or sudden emotional shock.

cups.02: Warm romantic connection and mutual trust.
cups.04: Living in memories instead of the present.
cups.07: Idealizing the past or emotional fantasies.

wands.02: Balancing future plans with past experience.
wands.10: Emotional burden caused by past issues.
wands.12: Impulsive return to old habits or relationships.
wands.14: Strong emotional partnership and mutual trust.
